blocks.text: JM Ibarra confronted a director after his love team partner, Fyang Smith, allegedly received a disrespectful remark during a recent content shoot. The incident was discussed during the “Deep Truth” segment of “Gandang Gabi Vice” on Sept. 20, where Smith recalled feeling uncomfortable with the director’s remarks. “Naka-content shoot ako. Siyempre, maiikli ang suot, naka-tube lang ako. Una pa lang, naiilang na ako kasi ang dami niyang sinasabi. Pero ako siyempre dahil director siya, respectful ako,” Smith said.
